decision: Selected the area centroid of the union of the six Gemarkung Neu-Rahlstedt parcels that the Bezirksamt Wandsbek building permit W/WBZ/04845/2021 ('Errichtung eines Rechenzentrums') names, read from the official Hamburg ALKIS WFS in EPSG:25832 and transformed to WGS84, as the project locator for akquinet's Victoria Park data centre.
identity_bridge: Bezirksamt Wandsbek building permit GZ W/WBZ/04845/2021 of 29 December 2021 (Baugenehmigungsverfahren nach § 62 HBauO, application received 25.03.2021): 'Errichtung eines Rechenzentrums' on Flurstücke 2475, 2403, 2421, 2474, 2477 and 2479 in Gemarkung Neu-Rahlstedt, Baublock 526-186; the street address is redacted. The Transparenzportal dataset page (published 12.01.2022) repeats the parcels and adds Bebauungsplan Rahlstedt 131.

akquinet's Victoria Park page: its fourth data centre, in Hamburg-Rahlstedt; '10/2020 Standort gefunden' (a 10,750 m2 building plot 'im Victoria Park in Hamburg-Rahlstedt' acquired in October 2020); '03/2021 Baugenehmigung eingereicht', matching the permit's receipt date of 25 March 2021; operation started 08/2024 and the official opening was 05/2025. Its flyer describes 12 underground system rooms.

Watson Farley & Williams release of 2 November 2026: the acquired 'Leuchtturm and Rahlstedt data centres located in Hamburg-Alsterdorf and Hamburg-Rahlstedt', both operated by akquinet (spelled 'aquinet'), are 'two fully operational data centres'.

akquinet names one data centre in Hamburg-Rahlstedt (its overview page lists four sites: Hamburg-Rahlstedt, Hamburg-Alsterdorf, Norderstedt and Itzehoe), and the permit's parcels carry the location text 'Victoriaring 14' in ALKIS, consistent with the 'Victoria Park' business park in Rahlstedt that its page names.

consistency_checks.parcel_query: The WFS filter (Gemarkung Neu-Rahlstedt AND flstnrzae in the six permit numbers) returns exactly six parcels, one per permit number; their union is a single polygon.
consistency_checks.operator_plot_area_check: akquinet gives a 10,750 m2 plot. The permit parcels total 7,115 m2. The adjoining parcel 2476 ('Victoriaring; südlich Victoriaring 14', 3,612 m2, about 108 m of shared boundary) and parcel 2478 (23 m2) bring the union to 10,748 m2 (bbox query hh-alkis-flst-victoriaring-bbox.gml). That union's centroid lies 17.5 m from the selected point, which is inside it. Parcel 2476 is not in the permit and is not used for the point.
consistency_checks.alkis_buildings: ALKIS GebaeudeBauwerk (hh-alkis-gebaeude-victoriaring-14.gml): building DEHHALKAx30000PHBL at 'Victoriaring 14' (2,243 m2 footprint) and an underground storey part DEHHALKAx30000P4BL (Keller, 3,088 m2), plus two 2-storey parts of about 173 m2; all lie wholly inside the permit-parcel union. The selected point lies inside the building and the basement footprints, 4.9 m from the building centroid. ALKIS records the building function as 'Bürogebäude', which is not used as evidence of use.

transform_check: Parcel polygons (EPSG:25832, LGV Hamburg ALKIS vereinfacht WFS) unioned and centroid computed with shapely 2.1.1, then transformed to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1), always_xy, rounded to 7 decimals; round trip 1 mm.

excluded_coordinates.reason: Company office address, not the data centre.

excluded_coordinates.kind: Rahlstedt district centre or Victoria Park business-park centroid

limitations: The point is a derived interior point of the permit-named parcels, about 112 by 72 m. It is not a surveyed building position, and the operator's plot of 10,750 m2 probably also includes parcel 2476 to the south.
